name: hcapp_getRunPhotos
description: Returns photos for a run in two rowsets. Rowset 1 — the caller's own photos (every status, soft-deleted included, always fully returned, with AssetId for device-local display). Rowset 2 — others' photos the caller may see: Status >= 3 (public) for everyone, Status = 2 (members) only when HC.KennelAccessTier(@userId, photo's kennel) gives Tier >= 10 — the single audience oracle; soft-deleted excluded; filterable by @afterUpdatedAt for incremental updates. Call on demand when the map or photo UI is active; do not poll. Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 32, @param NULL). The eventId check runs before the TRY; the SELECTs are wrapped, with runtime errors logged and re-thrown.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Passed to HC6.ValidateAppAuth for auth resolution.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived auth token validated against DeviceSecret.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: The run to fetch photos for. Null or zero-UUID triggers a validation error (errorCode 1232, errorType 12).

parameters.name: afterUpdatedAt
parameters.description: Incremental watermark applied to others' public photos only (rowset 2). NULL = return all matching records (initial load). Non-null = return only records where UpdatedAt > @afterUpdatedAt. Own photos (rowset 1) always return fully regardless of this value. Defaults to NULL.

rowsets.name: AuthErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: On auth failure (ValidateAppAuth) or missing eventId (1232/12): { success=0, errorCode, errorType }, paired with StandardErrorResult at index 1. Not present on success.
Returned only on auth or validation failure (paired with AuthErrorEnvelope at index 0). Not present on success.

rowsets.name: OwnPhotos
rowsets.description: On success: all photos uploaded by the caller for this event, regardless of status and INCLUDING soft-deleted rows (DeletedAt is not filtered — nor returned, see codeSmells). Always fully returned — @afterUpdatedAt does not apply. Includes AssetId for device-local display fallback. Zero rows if the user has no photos for this event. Mutually exclusive with StandardErrorResult at index 1.

columns.name: UserId
columns.description: KennelPhotos.UserId — always the authenticated user's ID in this rowset.

columns.name: BlobUrl
columns.description: KennelPhotos.BlobUrl — CDN URL of the original uploaded image.

columns.name: EditedBlobUrl
columns.description: KennelPhotos.EditedBlobUrl — CDN URL of the edited version, if any.

columns.name: AssetId
columns.description: KennelPhotos.AssetId — device-library identifier (iOS/Android). Only valid on the device that took the photo. NULL if the user had camera roll saving disabled.

columns.name: Featured
columns.description: KennelPhotos.Featured — 1 when a reviewer starred the photo.

columns.name: TakenAtUtc
columns.description: When the photo was taken (UTC). NULL for rows written before capture time was recorded — callers fall back to the PHO:: track point.

rowsets.name: OthersPublicPhotos
rowsets.description: On success: photos by other users with DeletedAt NULL and (Status >= 3, or Status = 2 and the caller is member-tier for the photo's kennel via HC.KennelAccessTier Tier >= 10), filtered by UpdatedAt > @afterUpdatedAt when given. Includes uploaderDisplayName. Zero rows if none qualify. Not present on error paths.

columns.name: UserId
columns.description: KennelPhotos.UserId — the uploader's ID (never the authenticated user in this rowset).

columns.name: BlobUrl
columns.description: KennelPhotos.BlobUrl — CDN URL of the original uploaded image.

columns.name: EditedBlobUrl
columns.description: KennelPhotos.EditedBlobUrl — CDN URL of the edited version, if any.

columns.name: Status
columns.description: KennelPhotos.Status — always >= 2 in this rowset; 2 only when the caller is member-tier for the kennel.

columns.name: TakenAtUtc
columns.description: When the photo was taken (UTC). NULL for rows written before capture time was recorded — callers fall back to the PHO:: track point.

columns.name: UpdatedAt
columns.description: KennelPhotos.UpdatedAt — UTC last-modified timestamp. Used as the incremental watermark on the next call.

columns.name: uploaderDisplayName
columns.description: Hasher.DisplayName (persisted computed column) — the display name of the uploader.

sideEffects: INSERT HC.ErrorLog on missing eventId (line 72) and from the CATCH block (lines 143-145, after ROLLBACK)

codeSmells.detail: @deviceId, @accessToken and @eventId (lines 3-5) have no SQL default. A client that omits @eventId gets 'expects parameter' — an unlogged empty 500 before the SP runs, so the graceful 1232 check at line 69 is unreachable for an omitted parameter.

codeSmells.issue: OwnPhotos returns soft-deleted rows without DeletedAt
codeSmells.detail: Lines 88-107 select the caller's photos with no DeletedAt filter and do not return the DeletedAt column, so a photo the hasher (or a reviewer) deleted comes back indistinguishable from a live one; the client would re-draw it. Either filter DeletedAt IS NULL as rowset 2 does (line 131) or return the column.

codeSmells.issue: Per-row inline table-valued function in the WHERE clause
codeSmells.detail: Lines 135-137 call HC.KennelAccessTier(@userId, kp.KennelId) inside an EXISTS per candidate row of rowset 2. It is an inline TVF, so the optimiser can fold it, but every photo of a kennel the caller is not a member of pays the lookup; per-run volumes are small so this is noted, not a problem.
The SP sets SET NOCOUNT ON only. Harmless for a read with no transaction, but inconsistent with the HC6 SP standard, which requires both.

breakingChanges: New SP — no HC5 predecessor. No breaking changes from migration.
